message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What Happens | |---------|--------------| | **Goal** | Be the first player to score 500 points (or whatever you agree on). Points are earned by being the first to finish each round. | | **Setup** | • 108‑card deck (standard Uno deck).
• Each player draws 7 cards.
• Place the remaining deck face‑down as the draw pile.
• Flip the top card of the draw pile to start the discard pile. If it’s an action card, follow its effect immediately. | | **Turn Order** | Clockwise (unless a Reverse card changes direction). | | **Playing a Card** | On your turn you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard.
• If you can’t play, you must draw one card from the draw pile.
• If that drawn card is playable, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player loses their turn.
• **Reverse** – changes play direction.
• **Draw Two (+2)** – next player draws two cards and loses their turn.
• **Wild** – you choose the new color.
• **Wild Draw Four (+4)** – you choose the new color; next player draws four cards and loses their turn. (Can only be played if you have no matching color; otherwise you can be challenged.) | | **Wild Draw Four Challenge** | If a player believes the previous player had a playable card of the same color, they may challenge.
• If the challenger is correct, the original player draws four cards.
• If the challenger is wrong, the challenger draws six cards. | | **Calling “Uno”** | When you have **exactly one card left**, you must say “UNO” before the next player takes their turn.
• If you forget and another player points it out before the next turn starts, you must draw two cards as a penalty. | | **Winning a Round** | The first player to discard all their cards wins the round. | | **Scoring** | • Winner gets points equal to the sum of all cards left in opponents’ hands:
 – Number cards = face value.
 – Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points each.
 – Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points each.
• Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Optional Variations** | • **Stacking** – allow players to stack Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards instead of drawing.
• **Custom rules** – e.g., “No Wild Draw Four” or “Draw Three” cards. | **Quick Tips** 1. **Keep track of colors** – try to play cards that match the current color to avoid drawing. 2. **Use action cards strategically** – save a Skip or Reverse for when you’re about to win. 3. **Watch your opponents** – if they’re close to UNO, be ready to challenge a Wild Draw Four. Enjoy the fast‑paced, colorful fun of Uno!
